style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, warm golden interior light
motion_rule: she stays in the tall leather chair and the chair keeps its spot on the floor; she kicks the floor and the chair whips round at 1.6, 5.0, 7.2 and 8.6, the lit city sweeping behind her; the courier moth crosses through the lens and loose papers blast across the frame in EVERY beat; she throws something with her whole body in EVERY beat, arms and wings wide; new side of the chair and new shot size every beat; she fills half the frame height; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump grey clothes moth in a rich brown mink coat with a huge lush collar chewed ragged, powdery wings, feathered antennae, in a tall leather office chair
second_characters: ONE lean moth in a headset, always within a wing of the lens, hauling papers and folders through the frame in every beat
props: ONE battered leather briefcase crammed with papers at her feet; ONE oval portrait frame on the desk; furry mic bottom right
environment: a rich top floor office in a skyscraper, floor to ceiling glass behind the chair, the low sun over the sea and the bright city below, a wide polished desk

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty female voice, flat and bored, even 4.4 syllables/sec, every word stretched to its own window
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-4.1 one breath, short breath at 4.1, 4.1-7.2 one breath; after 7.2 only sfx
audio.pronunciation: BA-bush-ki-nu, SHU-bu, do-YE-la, BA-bush-ku, do-YE-li, dol-GHI, za-TO, PLA-tit, i-po-TE-ke
audio.lip_sync: her mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: papers rustling, paper tearing, fur ripping, the chair creaking and whipping round, a glass frame smashing at 2.6, a briefcase slam at 7.0

timeline.a: she rips a fistful of fur out of the huge collar and it bursts across the lens
she swings the stripped collar across the lens, the courier wiping the frame with a folder
she kicks the floor, the chair whips round and the lit city sweeps behind her
she hurls the oval portrait frame off the desk past the lens
she rips a fistful of papers out of the briefcase and blasts them at the lens
she throws both arms wide as the courier hauls folders through the lens
she kicks the floor and sweeps a whole armful of papers off the desk at the lens
she swings the briefcase up over her head and hurls it past the lens
chest-up: the chair whips her into the lens as she throws a fistful of fur at the camera
the courier lunges through the lens and slams a stack of folders onto the desk
she kicks the desk, the chair spins wide and the glowing city sweeps behind her
she punches a fist clean through the stripped collar and grins wide at the camera

must_appear: the first word is heard at 0.0; the courier is in frame every beat; papers fly across the lens every beat; at 2.3 she hurls the portrait frame past the lens; at 7.2 the chair whips her into the lens; at 9.3 she grins at the camera
negative_prompt: a silent opening, a still last second, conveyor belt, cart, rail under the chair, a hero riding anything, a hero nibbling or chewing, a prop held still, an empty frame behind her, darkness, night, dark scene, letterbox, a horizontal frame, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, digits, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, speech after 7.2
